# TuringTec Agent Studio — Bilingual (EN + ES) Production B2B AI Agents, MCP Servers & n8n Kits

- Spanish Storefront (4 Demos en Vivo): https://gabhack.github.io/turingtec-agent-studio/es/
- Gumroad Official Store ($39–$99 Kits): https://gabbler407.gumroad.com/
- Open-Core AWS FinOps CLI + MCP: https://github.com/gabhack/aws-finops-guard
- Apify Dual-Mode MCP Suite: https://github.com/gabhack/apify-cloud-mcp-suite
- CloudCert Lab Simulator: https://gabhack.github.io/cloudcert-lab/
